title: A Simple Transformer Pipeline for Full-Key Side-Channel Attacks on Uncropped Datasets
abstract: arXiv:2608.30105v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep learning-based side-channel analysis has historically focused on single-byte targets and manually cropped traces, which risks discarding exploitable leakage. While recent work has proposed specialized architectures and resampling techniques to address this gap, the literature lacks a simple transformer baseline for simultaneous full-key attacks on uncropped traces. We present an open-source transformer implementation for uncropped full-key attacks which uses the standard transformer encoder backbone, adapting only the input and output layers to the side-channel setting. We release our implementation, training recipes, and pretrained weights for uncropped ASCADv1f, ASCADv1r, and CHES-CTF-2018 which achieve performance competitive with previously-reported results, while using less than 10GB of VRAM and requiring at most 3.34 hours of training on a single NVIDIA A6000.

translated_title: 一种用于未裁剪数据集上全密钥侧信道攻击的简单Transformer流水线
translated_abstract: 基于深度学习的侧信道分析历来专注于单字节目标和人工裁剪的轨迹，这存在丢弃可利用泄漏信息的风险。尽管近期的工作已提出专门的架构和重采样技术来弥补这一空白，但文献中仍缺少一个可在未裁剪轨迹上同时进行全密钥攻击的简单Transformer基线。我们提出了一种用于未裁剪全密钥攻击的开源Transformer实现，该实现采用标准的Transformer编码器骨干网络，仅对输入层和输出层进行适配以适应侧信道场景。我们发布了针对未裁剪的ASCADv1f、ASCADv1r和CHES-CTF-2018数据集的实现、训练方案和预训练权重，其性能与先前报告的结果相当，同时显存占用低于10GB，且在单张NVIDIA A6000上的训练时间最多仅需3.34小时。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个开源的简单Transformer实现，可直接在未裁剪的侧信道轨迹数据集上同时进行全密钥攻击，性能与现有结果相当，且计算开销极低（显存低于10GB、训练时间不超过3.34小时）。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an open-source, simple transformer implementation for simultaneous full-key side-channel attacks on uncropped traces, achieving performance competitive with prior results while requiring less than 10GB of VRAM and at most 3.34 hours of training.
